meta.comment: Central tuning file. Edit numbers here instead of in JS. Future systems will read from this config.

loop.comment: GameLoop tuning. tickRateMs is the fixed simulation step; uiRefreshRateMs throttles 'loop:uiRefresh' emissions; maxFrameDeltaMs clamps per-frame deltas so tab switches cannot cause huge time jumps.

save.comment: SaveManager tuning. autosaveIntervalMs is how often the game autosaves (0 disables the interval); saveOnUnload persists on beforeunload.

futureSystems.comment: Add per-system tuning blocks below as systems are implemented.
